about: GET /v1/simulate/ladder bodies and the simulate_ladder MCP text over the #166 fixture (tests_ladder.rs): spot $0.012944, wallet USDC 1545.8357 and NOCK 90086.7891, floor 100000 with 1000 bps, reserve $950.

assumptions: Every NOCK pool moves by the same percentage as spot, each from its own current price; row 0 of the grid is the snapshot.
Fees and gas are not counted.
WETH/NOCK ranges hold ETH/USD constant and add no USDC.
Gas-side ranges with no NOCK leg (ETH/USDC, #151) are left out of the stable balance and the NOCK totals.
The ladder's USDC comes from the wallet and its NOCK from wallet NOCK.

Fee intensity per unit of liquidity is taken as uniform across ticks within the measuring range: the estimate is the measuring range's average fee per unit of liquidity times this range's liquidity, not a measurement inside it (band_measured is the measurement inside it, where there is one).
Fees per unit of liquidity are shared by every range that contains the price (the same pool, the same fee tier).
The pool's swap volume is taken as unchanged by the new liquidity: only its share dilutes.

Dilution uses the pool's active liquidity at the current tick, read at 'latest' in the snapshot's cycle (not at the snapshot's block); the liquidity at the range's own ticks is not read and is taken as the same.
The NOCK fee leg is valued at the current pool price, not at the price when it accrued.
Intervals where the measuring range's liquidity changed or its fees fell (a collect, or a v4 add that collects) are skipped, so the measurement slightly undercounts; the seconds skipped are stated.
Gas is not counted. Past fees are not a forecast.
The stored market volume of another pool (market_price_history) is never used.
fee_estimate.reason: this snapshot has no fee_yield (2.10.0): fees are not measured in it

floor_breach_effect.assumption: Each pool is moved by the same multiple from its own current price. WETH/NOCK ranges hold ETH/USD constant (a NOCK/USD multiple is the same NOCK/ETH multiple). Full-range pools follow x*y=k on the wallet's share and never sell out. Uncollected NOCK fees count as held. Gas-side ranges with no NOCK leg hold no NOCK.
floor_breach_effect.reason: the ladder's NOCK leaves the wallet and sells as NOCK rises to the top

tool.description: Read-only what-if for a USDC/NOCK range (a 'ladder') below spot, or a ladder of up to 4 rungs (cap, near and deep) in one pool, from the latest stored snapshot: the liquidity and NOCK the inputs imply, NOCK bought and USDC left at each price down the grid, the full-conversion price and average buy price, the price where it is out of range above (all USDC), the stable balance at the reserve gate (the lower of the deepest bottom and your configured ladder bottom) against the protected cash reserve (counting the existing NOCK ranges' USDC converting on the way down), whether its NOCK fits the floor + tolerance budget, its effect on the floor-crossing price, and estimated fees per day while in range, measured from your own tracked range (with the in-range share of stored history and replay upper bounds beside it). With rungs it also draws trade-off tables (split and depths) as measurements, unranked. shape: 'configured' runs your own operator_profile.ladder_rungs. Bounds snap to a tracked pool's tick spacing (position_id) or a spacing you give (tick_spacing). Nothing is read on-chain, signed or sent; the amounts are yours.

grid_step_pct.description: Grid step, % of spot (0.5 to 20; default 5).

grid_to_pct.description: How far down the grid goes, % of spot (-95 to -1; default -40).

high.description: One-rung form: top of the range, USD per NOCK (or high_pct, or high_at_spot).

high_at_spot.description: One-rung form: true when the top is the pool price (on a snapped grid, the usable tick at or below it, holding no NOCK).

high_pct.description: One-rung form: top as % of the pool price, e.g. 2.

low.description: One-rung form: bottom of the range, USD per NOCK (or give low_pct).

low_pct.description: One-rung form: bottom as % of the pool price, e.g. -30.

nock.description: One-rung form, optional: the NOCK you would add with it; checked against what the range needs.

position_id.description: A tracked USDC/NOCK concentrated position whose pool and tick spacing the ladder would use.

rungs.description: A ladder of rungs in one pool, instead of the one-rung arguments: each {rung: cap|near|deep (required), usdc, nock?, low or low_pct, high or high_pct or high_at_spot}.

rung.description: The rung's role; required, never assumed.

shape.description: 'configured': your own operator_profile.ladder_rungs, instead of rungs or the one-rung arguments.

shape_usdc.description: With shape: the total USDC to size it to (default: the most the shared reserve gate allows).

split_step_pct.description: With rungs: the split table's step, % of the total (5 to 50; display default 10).

tick_spacing.description: A tick spacing you state, instead of position_id.

usdc.description: One-rung form: USDC the ladder holds at spot.
